map.GST（商品及服务税）多国采用，发票常标注含税价。输入含税或税前金额与税率，即可: GST is adopted by many countries; invoices often show tax-inclusive prices. Enter the inclusive or pre-tax amount and rate to split out the tax, easing reimbursement, filing and reconciliation.
map.GST 计算：不含税价 × 税率 = 税额；含税价 = 不含税价 ×（1 + 税: GST: pre-tax price x rate = tax; tax-inclusive = pre-tax x (1 + rate); reverse from inclusive: pre-tax = inclusive / (1 + rate); common rates: Singapore 9%, Australia 10%, India 18%, for cross-border quoting and invoice checks.
map.含税价 = 税前价 ×(1 + 税率)；税前价 = 含税价 ÷(1 + 税率)。: Inclusive = pre-tax x (1 + rate); pre-tax = inclusive / (1 + rate). Always distinguish the two bases when splitting tax.
map.常见 GST 税率：澳大利亚 10%、新西兰 15%、新加坡 9%、加拿大联邦: Common GST rates: Australia 10%, New Zealand 15%, Singapore 9%, Canada federal 5% (provinces add PST/HST); this tool handles any rate.
map.发票若标注「含税」而按税前算税会重复计税，报销前先确认金额性质。: If an invoice marks 'inclusive' but you tax it as pre-tax, you double-count; confirm the amount type before reimbursement.

map.含税价已包含 GST，不含税价是计税基准；换算时含税÷(1+率)得不含税，不含税: Inclusive price embeds GST; exclusive is the tax base. Convert: inclusive / (1+rate) = exclusive; exclusive x rate = tax.
